referee_caveats_inferred: Main inputs are team-processed ALMAGAL 7m+tm2 products, not archive products, so exact reproduction needs the ALMAGAL release
Linear resolution ~5000 au for 7m+tm2 means 'compact sources' are clump fragments, not cores, and beam size in pc differs among sources
Selection thresholds appear inconsistent: text gives 5 beams for the mask_ext intersection while the Table D.1 note says 10 beams for the largest region, and the 'first 40' versus 'first 37' sources
V_N values depend on mask choice, the gradient smoothing scale Omega (not given) and noise-level handling
Line optical depth and outflow contamination are not controlled, and fixed-range moment maps for 97 sources truncate wings
Differing sensitivities per line shape which sources enter each statistic, so medians are over varying sub-samples
